cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Hope with Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into believing that the outcome can still change, even when the evidence is thin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Help me choose glasses for our café. You spent years learning to spot what a customer wants; put that eye to work.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're on the waiting list. I haven't even told my mum.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No announcement, then. Just show me what you'd set down in front of her if we got the place.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A mug. She'd complain about these little glasses.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There, you've remembered to think about the customer. Pick her a proper big one. Can you picture us putting it on her table?

reason: Use specific familiar feedback and old pupil habits to shape the exact pursuit, without attributing every obstacle to a deliberate test. B actual contribution must change the next request.
